title: Bound BFF Strategy List and Detail Reads at 5,000+ Real-Scale Spec Rows

hosted_5031_row_population_facts.note: Retained coordinator population facts (5031 spec version rows across 4900 distinct strategy families; local fixture creates 2 retired families so 4900 - 2 = 4898 non-retired in fixture, not a fresh live hosted query).

slow_steps_identified: 1. PostgresRegistryStore.list_by_strategy previously called self.list_all_entries() and filtered in Python, scanning and decoding all 5,031 strategy_spec JSONB blobs (1.328s on hosted dev) even when reading 1 strategy (1-4 rows).

2. GET /bff/strategies/{id} and PATCH /bff/strategies/{id} called ctx.service.get_strategy(strategy_id) which fell back to scanning list_strategy_summaries() (all 4,898 strategies) even after get_strategy_spec_detail(strategy_id, version_selector='current') had already resolved the single strategy.

3. GET /bff/strategies fetched GET /api/registry/strategy-specs (all 5,031 rows / 24.35 MB on hosted dev, 17.28 MB in local 5,031-row fixture), parsed all 5,031 JSON objects (0.256s-0.274s), normalized all 4,900 families through _kw05_normalize_version_candidate with repeated copy.deepcopy calls (1.085s uncached + 0.959s deepcopy on hosted dev; 2.75s of 3.33s under cProfile), only to slice 20 items.

4. project_strategy_dto fell back to detail.get('source_kind') and summary.get('hypothesis_excerpt') when market_scope.alpha was absent, causing GET /bff/strategies list items to show truncated hypothesis text as alpha while GET /bff/strategies/{id} detail showed 'workflow'.

details: PostgresRegistryStore.list_by_strategy now queries WHERE payload ->> 'strategy_id' = %s ORDER BY created_at ASC instead of scanning list_all_entries().

PostgresRegistryStore.list_strategy_spec_summary_rows projects only leaf JSONB fields needed for version sorting, tenant/state/persona filtering, and BFF summary DTO projection without transferring full inline strategy_spec bodies.

Added GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=strategy_summary_page supporting tenant visibility, state (including BFF aliases review->candidate and deployed->active), persona_id, page_size, and page_token, returning {'items': [...], 'total': <int>, 'next_page_token': <str|None>} ordered by (last_modified_at DESC, strategy_id DESC).

DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort.list_strategy_specs_page calls GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=strategy_summary_page with state, persona_id, page_size, and page_token, requiring a typed dict envelope (failing closed with 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE on unexpected raw-list or malformed payloads) and validating caller tenant isolation on every returned item.

StrategiesService.list_strategy_summaries_page delegates directly to the declared public read_store.list_strategy_summaries_page / list_strategy_specs_page dependency without callable/bytecode/dict reflection, so lambda, equivalent named wrappers, and bound methods route identically to the bounded owner summary page while genuine legacy whole-list stores without the page method remain on list_strategy_summaries().

detail.py (GET /bff/strategies/{id} and PATCH /bff/strategies/{id}) reuses the single-strategy get_strategy_spec_detail(strategy_id, version_selector='current') read (GET /api/registry/strategies/{id}/strategy-specs) directly when it resolves a strategy dict, without triggering a full list_strategy_summaries() scan.
common.py (project_strategy_dto) sets alpha strictly from market_scope.alpha (defaulting to '') so list and detail always agree and never leak source_kind or hypothesis_excerpt into alpha.

guarantees: Projected exclusively from the already-resolved current owner version in GET /bff/strategies/{id} (include_spec=True); no extra owner read or endpoint.
Exposes only values actually present in the resolved owner version; empty or absent sub-objects become None.
Metadata is strictly allowlisted to market, execution_context, traits.instruments, and traits.time_horizon; arbitrary metadata blobs and secrets are never exposed.
Does not invent evaluation_plan.benchmark when absent in the canonical owner version.
Not included on GET /bff/strategies paged list items and stripped before persisting on PATCH /bff/strategies/{id}.

ac1_evidence_measures_time_at_5000_plus_.notes: Measured both hosted 5,031-row (24.35 MB) timings and local 5,031-row (4,900 families / 4,898 non-retired) before/after step breakdown in root_cause_and_slow_steps.

ac6_no_existing_test_weakened_or_deleted.justification: All existing tests in test_strategy_list_latency.py, test_strategy_metrics_truth.py, test_strategy_ranking_router.py, and services/registry/test_service.py are preserved intact without weakening or deleting assertions; new tests were appended for 5,031-row scale boundary assertions, SQL pushdown, alpha parity, detail data.spec projection, equivalent callable wrapper routing, and fail-closed 503 rejection of unexpected raw-list owner responses on the summary page route.
